news.headline: US intelligence says woman close to Nvidia CEO was a Chinese spy, prompting congressional inquiry
news.summary: U.S. intelligence officials concluded that a woman who developed a close relationship with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security. Republican committee chairs have sent a letter requesting Huang appear before Congress to brief them on the matter. The issue raises concerns about potential espionage and national security risks tied to a leading technology company. Lawmakers from both parties are seeking answers as the story unfolds.

news.headline: House Democrats Back Impeachment Resolution Against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth
news.summary: House Minority Leader Hakeen Jeffries announced a "hard yes" to impeaching Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth. The move follows a wave of Democratic victories in the recent midterms and comes as some Republican members are reported to be considering defections. The resolution is being positioned as a response to alleged abuses of power by the secretary. The outcome could set a precedent for impeachment proceedings against a sitting cabinet official.

news.headline: Trump offers UFC CEO Dana White White House press secretary position
news.summary: President Donald Trump posted on Truth Social that he has offered the White House press secretary job to UFC chief Dana White. The post noted that White could bring several UFC fighters as assistants. The offer follows the recent departure of former press secretary Katie Zacharia. The announcement has drawn attention due to White's background in mixed‑martial‑arts promotion.

news.headline: Dave Chappelle jokes about feeling better after Charlie Kirk's murder at Madison Square Garden
news.summary: Comedian Dave Chappelle made a remark during his Madison Square Garden show that he feels better since the killing of Turning Point USA founder Charlie Kirk. The comment was captured on video and quickly spread across media outlets. The remark sparked outrage among Kirk supporters and conservative commentators, while also drawing criticism from left-leaning observers. The incident highlights tensions between free speech in comedy and reactions to political violence.

news.headline: Podcasters Jennifer Welch and Angie Sullivan face sponsor fallout after joking about Charlie Kirk
news.summary: Left‑leaning podcasters Jennifer Welch and Angie Sullivan laughed at a social‑media post that referenced digging up and killing conservative commentator Charlie Kirk. The joke sparked outrage, leading several advertisers, including Cash App and Chewy, to end their sponsorships. The hosts later issued apologies for the insensitive remarks. The incident highlights heightened partisan tensions surrounding political commentary and sponsor sensitivities.

news.headline: Trump replaces chief of staff Susie Wiles with Stephen Miller after midterm losses
news.summary: President Donald Trump announced that Susie Wiles is leaving her role as White House chief of staff and that longtime adviser Stephen Miller will assume the position. The change comes days after Republicans suffered significant defeats in the midterm elections, losing control of the Senate and many House seats. The administration said the move is part of a broader re‑organization following the electoral setback.

news.headline: Small plane makes emergency landing on Florida highway, clips pickup truck
news.summary: A Cessna 172D Skyhawk experienced a mechanical problem and performed an emergency landing on a north‑Fort Myers highway, striking the rear of a pickup truck. Two people were aboard the aircraft and no injuries were reported for either the pilots or the truck driver. The incident was captured on video and is being investigated by local authorities. The event highlights safety concerns for low‑altitude emergency landings on public roads.

news.headline: Democratic senator-elect James Talarico appears on SNL after Texas Senate win
news.summary: James Talarico, the newly elected Democratic senator from Texas, made a surprise appearance during a cold open on Saturday Night Live. He delivered a brief joke referencing a text campaign and the show's political satire. The appearance follows his upset victory in a traditionally Republican state, highlighting the shifting political landscape. The segment drew attention from both liberal and conservative media outlets.

news.headline: Democrats win key Florida House seats despite GOP redistricting push
news.summary: Incumbent Democrat Jared Moskowitz was projected to win re-election in Florida's 25th Congressional District, and Democrat Pia Dandiya was projected to win the 22nd District. Both victories occurred after the Republican-led mid-decade redistricting plan aimed to create additional GOP-leaning districts. The outcomes preserve Democratic representation in the state House and challenge the expected advantage from the new maps. Analysts note the results could influence future redistricting and party strategies in Florida.

news.headline: Trump directs DOJ to investigate Democrats over alleged impeachment threats
news.summary: President Donald Trump announced he is asking the Justice Department to look into claims that Democratic lawmakers are threatening impeachment of Republican officials and donors. The request follows the recent Democratic gains in Congress and comes amid heightened partisan tension. Trump says the alleged threats constitute extortion, while the DOJ has not yet confirmed any investigation. The move raises questions about the use of federal investigative power for political disputes.
